description: Boot or prepare the selected device or simulator so later commands can target it. The device is chosen through the device-selection inputs, not by naming it here. On Limrun, allocate or reuse an instance. Existing-instance credentials attach without creating one. Times out after 90s; a caller-supplied budget extends it.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

headless.description: Boot without showing simulator UI when supported.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

pick.description: When no device is named and several equally preferred devices match, all shut down, boot one instead of failing: newest picks mobile over TV, then the newest OS version, then the first name in name order (numbers compared by value; not device age), which alone decides for stopped Android AVDs because they report no OS version. Several booted matches still fail.

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

timeoutMs.description: Startup budget in milliseconds. Bounds the boot wait, so a never-booted Simulator can finish its first-boot migration or a cold emulator its boot; omit for the default startup behavior.

name: boot
